name: leases
description: The lease table every DHCP source reports into: data source 4. Every provider of the dhcp_lease kind -- kea, dnsmasq, isc, or one a third party ships -- is granted the table and writes what its server reports, one row per lease generation; this plugin's derivation then names the interface each lease was given on, from the installation model, and purges what the installation's retention no longer keeps. The clients plugin reads the leases as on-link evidence and names the client each lease belongs to (ADR 0019, ADR 0020 wave 4).

columns.name: generation_key
columns.generated: CASE WHEN starts_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'start:' || starts_at WHEN expires_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'expiry:' || expires_at ELSE 'observed_day:' || ((observed_at / 86400) * 86400) END

columns.name: hostname_label
columns.generated: lower(CASE WHEN strpos(rtrim(hostname, '.'), '.') > 0 THEN substr(rtrim(hostname, '.'), 1, strpos(rtrim(hostname, '.'), '.') - 1) ELSE rtrim(hostname, '.') END)

checks.name: mac_shape
checks.expression: mac IS NULL OR (length(mac) = 17 AND mac = lower(mac))

checks.name: starts_at_instant
checks.expression: starts_at IS NULL OR (starts_at >= 0 AND starts_at < 4102444800)

checks.name: expires_at_instant
checks.expression: expires_at IS NULL OR (expires_at >= 0 AND expires_at < 4102444800)
